summary: MeiraGTx Holdings plc filed an 8-K reporting the initial closing of a strategic collaboration with Hologen Limited on April 20, 2026. The deal includes amendments to existing framework agreements and a Collaboration and License Agreement for gene therapy programs and a delivery device. Hologen subscribed for Class B shares in a subsidiary in consideration for a portion of $105 million. MeiraGTx contributes its AAV-GAD and AAV-BDNF programs and device. The board recommendation is not stated; no advisor named. The transaction involves a non-US structure (Guernsey, UK entities) but maps to an acquisition of assets/equity. What to watch: regulatory milestones and completion of remaining closings; risk-arb focuses on milestone payments and development progress.
